description: React functional component 'AddNote' that provides a textarea for user input, manages note text state, enforces a character limit, and handles saving notes via a callback.

methods.name: AddNote
methods.description: React functional component for adding notes with character limit and save functionality.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change, updates noteText state if within character limit.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Handles save button click, calls handleAddNote callback if noteText is not empty, then resets noteText.
